 Follow Ethan Hawke and Uma Thurman's famous lookalike daughter wows in daring crop top – 9 months after surprise wedding
 Ella Rayment-Ward Tue, November 17, 2026 at 4:46 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Maya Hawke is the daughter of Uma Thurman and Ethan Hawke (Getty) Uma Thurman and Ethan Hawke 's famous lookalike daughter Maya Hawke has returned to the red carpet with a red-hot look. 
 The Stranger Things actress, 28, reunited with her Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping co-stars for the film's star-studded world premiere in New York on 16 November – and she looked worlds apart from her on-screen appearance in the popular dystopian movie franchise. 
 Newlywed Maya bared her midriff on the red carpet in a custom Prada red crop top and low-rise black maxi skirt, which draped elegantly to the floor, concealing her platform heels. While fans might be used to seeing Maya's hair in an 80s-style bob on Stranger Things or with a dark, choppy fringe in The Hunger Games , the actress has returned to her real-life natural sandy brown colour, which has grown out to below her shoulders. 
 Maya Hawke attends the New York premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping on 16 November (@ WireImage)
 Maya styled her hair in a sleek side part and showed off the dazzling diamond on her ring finger after tying the knot with musician Christian Lee Hutson in New York in February 2026. The star's famous parents were both in attendance for their daughter's winter wonderland wedding, with Uma appearing to be Maya's "something blue" for the special occasion. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Ethan and Uma, who finalised their divorce in 2005, also share a son named Levon, who has similarly followed in his family's footsteps as an actor.

 Maya's Hunger Games role
 Maya has transformed into a younger version of Wiress, first played by actress Amanda Plummer in 2013's The Hunger Games : Catching Fire , for the highly anticipated Sunrise on the Reaping . The upcoming Hunger Games prequel is set 24 years before the events of the original trilogy and sees several actors portraying the younger counterparts of the franchise's favourite characters, including Joseph Zada as Haymitch Abernathy and Elle Fanning as Elizabeth Banks' Effie Trinket. 
 Maya opened up about joining the popular franchise, and revealed the Hunger Games actually made her want to pursue acting. 
 Maya Hawke in Sunrise on the Reaping (@ Lionsgate/ YouTube)
 "I credit the original Hunger Games movie a lot with inspiring me to want to be an actor, honestly," she told People in July. She explained that "it's so hard to give a good performance in a big action movie," because "so many pieces in the machine are usually working against the capacity to give a good performance."
 Advertisement Advertisement Referencing Jennifer Lawrence's portrayal of Katniss Everdeen in particular, Maya added: "In those movies, she gave a performance so singularly excellent and weird, and she painted a true individual that was not at all neutralised by the genre."
 Jennifer Lawrence returns to the Hunger Games
 After confirming she's reprising her role in the upcoming instalment, Jennifer reunited with her Hunger Games co-stars at the New York premiere on Monday night. 
 Josh Hutcherson and Jennifer Lawrence reunited at the Sunrise on the Reaping premiere (@ WireImage)
 The Oscar-winning actress looked glamorous in a Dior dress robe with a fluffy white trim on the neckline as she posed for pictures with her on-screen love interest Josh Hutcherson and other Hunger Games alum, including Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks. 
 After much speculation, Jennifer and Josh have been confirmed to return in Sunrise on the Reaping , with author Suzanne Collins praising them for bringing "such poignancy to the film" in a rare statement. Woody will also be back as Haymitch in the film, which follows his character 24 years earlier, played by Australian rising star Joseph Zada.
